clauses.reason: Terminated by express revocation. Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 (51 FR 7237, Federal Register of March 3, 1986; held government printing) revokes the orders listed in its table, and any amendments thereto; its enacting provision has no stated effective date, so the first end is dated on signing, 1986-02-25 (a reading, disclosed for the reviewer). The Federal Register publication and filing dates are not effective dates. The table lists 12447, whose subject line describes continuing the President’s Private Sector Survey on Cost Control in the Federal Government. The single sentence amends section 4(b) of Executive Order 12369, as amended, to read that the Committee (the President’s Private Sector Survey on Cost Control in the Federal Government) terminates on December 31, 1983, unless sooner extended. The December 31, 1983 date never operated as an end: Executive Order 12455 of December 29, 1983 amended the same section 4(b) before that date (before: terminate on December 31, 1983; after: terminate on January 31, 1984, unless sooner extended); under owner ruling 2026-10-21 that is a strike-and-insert amendment, the clause continues, amended, and the substance (the termination date) changed. Executive Order 12534 of September 30, 1985 (held Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12534.txt; not among this packet’s citable evidence) revokes the parent order 12369 but does not name this order; under owner ruling 2026-10-21 (unnamed instruments) it is a disclosed candidate earlier end for the reviewer and not an end, and it is not recorded as a later event. The parent committee's amended termination date is a disclosed earlier candidate and not the first end: as further amended by Executive Order 12455 (signed December 29, 1983; 49 FR 345) section 4(b) of Executive Order No. 12369 provides that the Committee shall terminate on January 31, 1984, unless sooner extended, no held instrument extends it, and section 3 of Executive Order 12534 (signed September 30, 1985; 50 FR 40320, October 2, 1985) revokes Executive Order No. 12369 as one of the orders that established committees that have terminated or been abolished by statute or whose work is completed. The Committee, and with it the termination date this order set, therefore had no operation after January 31, 1984 (functionally spent on that date on the inclusive reading; the recital in Executive Order 12534 does not say which of its three alternatives applies to this Committee). Neither instrument names Executive Order 12447, so under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on unnamed instruments they are not ends; this order remained on the books until Executive Order 12553 revoked it by number. No earlier express end was found.
